name: Present/Perceptual/Consciousness
source:
Present perceptual consciousness refers to the subjective experience of the current moment.  

– A story of pygmalion and paper dolls. 
– A story of a girl and her creator. 

[From [url=https://haunted-oyster.itch.io/presentpercep]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当前的感性意识是指当前时刻的主观体验。

– 皮格马利翁和纸娃娃的故事。
– 一个女孩和她的创造者的故事。

[来自[url=https://haunted-oyster.itch.io/presentpercep]Itch.io[/url]]
